description: This file is an HTML source that renders a documentation and demo page for the CodeMirror syntax highlighter's SCSS mode. It includes embedded SCSS code in a textarea for syntax highlighting, references to JavaScript and CSS files, and provides user interface elements.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance from a textarea element with specified options such as lineNumbers, matchBrackets, and mode set to 'text/x-scss'.
